## Verdict

**Heronry** costs least for a team of 45, at **$405 per month**. Its 10-seat minimum sits below the team size, so all 45 seats bill at the list rate of $9 with no padding. Juno Board is next at $675, and Cygnus Flow is dearest at $945. All three minimums fall below 45, so this ranking is driven purely by per-seat rate.

## Vendors

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Juno Board | $15 | 40 |
| Cygnus Flow | $21 | 1 |
| Heronry | $9 | 10 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the larger of 45 (team size) or the vendor minimum. No minimum exceeds 45, so every vendor bills exactly 45 seats.

- **Juno Board:** minimum 40 < 45, so 45 seats paid. 45 × $15 = **$675 per month**.
- **Cygnus Flow:** minimum 1 < 45, so 45 seats paid. 45 × $21 = **$945 per month**.
- **Heronry:** minimum 10 < 45, so 45 seats paid. 45 × $9 = **$405 per month**.

Heronry is $270 per month cheaper than Juno Board and $540 per month cheaper than Cygnus Flow — $3,240 and $6,480 per year. Spread between cheapest and dearest is $540 per month. Effective rates match list rates for all three: $9.00, $15.00 and $21.00 per person.

## Risks

Seat minimums are inactive at this headcount, so they do not protect or penalise anyone here — but they bite if the team shrinks. Below 40 people Juno Board still bills $600; below 10, Heronry still bills $90. Cygnus Flow has no practical floor and is the only vendor that scales down cleanly.

Growth does not change the order. All three scale linearly above 45, so Heronry's lead widens in absolute terms with each added seat.

This is a price comparison only. The list carries no information on features, support tiers, usage limits, security posture or integrations, so the cheapest seat may buy the least product. Figures assume monthly billing at list price as stated; annual commitments, volume discounts, onboarding fees and switching costs are not in the source and could reorder these results.
